tei:titleStmt.tei:title: dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam nyid kun bzang bde chen mo/ /rol pa che shes klong dgu'i gar/ /dpal chen sgrub pa sde chen mo/ /rnam pa brgya
dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam nyid kun bzang bde chen mo/ /rol pa che shes klong dgu'i gar/ /dpal chen sgrub pa sde chen mo/ /rnam pa brgya

tei:div.tei:p: dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam nyid kun bzang bde chen mo// rol pa che shes klong dgu'i gar// dpal chen sgrub pa sde chen mo// rnam pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen 'dus pa yang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa ltar las/ bsnyen pa la bab pa'i skabs/ dang po/ zhi bar bsnyen pa bdag nyid sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci 'grub dang*/ gnyis pa khro bo sgrub pa la/ ye shes rgyal po sogs/ oṃ gu ru sogs ci 'grub dang*/ yang rang rang sngags sogs 'phror hūm̐ glu dang phaṭa dzas bdag mdun dbye/ lha tshogs kun kyang spyi dril sngags rjes su spyi dril sngags/ oṃ badzra tsanḍa sogs dang*/ de nasalas sbyor ni rgyun gyi nyams len la dkyus ltar dang*/ smad las dang 'brel ba'i skabs srung ba'i dmigs pa gtor bzlog gi mgor/ gtso bo'i thugs srog gi klad gor du bla ma sogs/ rtsa sngags srung sngags stong phrag tsam bzlas/ las sbyor khyad par ni/ skad cig gnam lcags rdo rje sogs/ sngags ci nus dang*/ drag sngags so lnga bas thun rdzas bsngags/ dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po brjod/ lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng sogs rig 'dus ltar ro// gsol ka sogs lhag ma'i bar btang*/ smad las la gser skyems byin gyis brlabs nas gser skyems sde brgyad cha snyom btang*/ gzu dpang nas bzlog pa'i bar dkyus bzhin btang*/ bzlog pa tshar grangs gsog na thun re re bzhin thun gtor 'phang*/ ltas ngan nam/ bsgral bya dmigs kyis bzlog dgos na/ rgyal mtshan dgu ma dang*/ rnga khyung*/ za lam zur gsal ltar btang ba dang*/ gzhung gi dbang phyug ma'i bzlog pa btang*/ zor 'phen pa la gser skyems rlabs/ hūm̐/ tshom bu dgu sogs phyi nang gi sgo dbye/ de rjes gzhung gi dngos grub len chog bya/ do gal che na dgug gzhug bcas ma mgon gyis ma mgon dam can sde brgyad kyi sngags kyis gtor ma phul/ ma mgon bskul ba yang btang*/

dpal chen gyi bskul ba dang chad mdobatang/ zor bskul gyi 'phror gong gi thun gtor 'phen pa des zor 'phen/ de nas brtan ma sogs rig 'dus ltar ro// ༈ seng gdong gi stod las la dang po bsnyen pa gtong ba'i dus su ni/ stod las rang gzhung yum bka' ltar btang*/ bsnyen pa grangs tshad bzhin dang*/ srung bzlog gi dmigs rim sbyar nas bsrung bzlog gnyis rim bzhin 'bum phrag re 'gro nges dgos/ smad las la ma mgon g.yu mdos dang 'brel na/ bdag bskyed dpal 'dus sam dgos sgrub bzhi gang rung nges par dgos/ rang bzhin bzlog pa grangs gsog dgos na/ bdag bskyed seng gdong stod las dang bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin btang*/ smad las la bdag bskyed gang ltar yang*/ swa bha sogs mdun rten sogs kyis mdun bskyed gsal btab nas bstod pa'i bar btang*/ bsnyen pa la babs pa na bdag bskyed dpal chen yin na 'dir stod las kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi dmigs sngags gnyis btang*/ bdag bskyed seng gdong gi stod las yin na/ smad las kyi/ bdud 'dul drag mo'i sogs ci nus bzlas/ bsrung bzlog gnyis kyi dmigs sngags sbrags nas stong phrag re las mi nyung bar bya'o// mjug tu bden pa brjod/ mchod bstod gzhung bzhin btang*/ smad las la/ hūm̐/ rten dang rten pa sogs kyis brub khang dang liṅga bskyed/ gser skyems brlabs nas rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud ma btang*/ bzlog pa'i mgor/ hūm̐/ zhi ba sogs kyis spyi bskul btang*/ de nas dzaḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi 'gugs pa lan gsum sogs dang 'gugs sngags rtags thon bar btang*/ bar 'dir zhal shes ltar ral gri drang srong lokt+ri ba'i ngo bor dmigs nas lokt+ri sngags kyi thun rdzas nus ldan du brlab/ de nas tsha khrus kyi dgongs pa gzhung bzhin la/ bzlog pa la spyi bskul nasa'agro/ grangs gsog na/ thun gtor rjes su bzlog pa'i sngags dmigs sbrags nas bzlog sngags ci mang bzlas/

mjug tu sangs rgyas kyi ni bdud rnams pham sogs bden stobs brjod/ 'phen pa'i nyin lhag ma'i rjes su/ hūm̐/ dbang po rdo rje sogs kyi sgo dbye/ bskul ba dang chad mdo gyer/ phyi rol du sde brgyad gser skyems btang*/ gal chen yin na ma mgon gyi bskul dang gtor ma 'phen/ gong gi thun gtor des gtor chen 'phen/ bstan ma skyong ba man chad yum bka' dang 'dra/ phyag bris las bshus/ zhus dag ༄༅/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa dpal he ru kaḥl phyag 'tshal lo// ma mgon g.yul mdos kyi 'don 'grigs zhal rgyun ci lta ba bzhin 'god pa la/ thog mar/ o rgyan yul gyi sogs lan gsum/ kun bzang rdor sems= 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= shes bya kun mkhyen= 'phags pa 'jig rten= phyi ltar rgyal ba'i= thog ma bab kyi= yon tan sangs rgyas= dpal ldan rtsa ba'i= sogs/ gzhung gi gsol 'debs mthar brgya brdung rol mo/ las bum sgrub pa ni/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa bcud kyis gtams pa'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag mi bzad pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyid su med par gyur/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pas bstod/ thugs kar nyi dkyil hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer me stag lta bu 'phros pas gdon bgegs dang sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ bdud rtsis rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra amri ta sogs ci nus bzla/ mthar dung chos 'bul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu ba khro bo'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/

bar bsam mo// de nas bdag bskyed dpal 'dus sam yum ka'i gsang sgrub seng gdong gi skyabs sems tshogs bsags bcas 'jam gdangs res mos kyi lan gsum btang mthar/ amṛ tas bsang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs/ stha na pa ti btags pa nam mdzod sngags rgyas lan gsum spel/ 'jam gdangs gis gang dag 'dir gnas sogs/ mthar sil rol bcas/ bgegs gtor la nam mkha' mdzod lan gsum gyis bsngos nas rol chen blang la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'beb gdangs gis 'geb/ srung 'khor 'bar ba stangs stabs kyi gdangs kyis/ brda sgo dbye ba phyag 'tshal/ nongs bshags/ dam bca' bzung ba/ byin 'bebs/ mthar brgyud gsum rol mo mthar bzhag rol/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ 'jam gdangs/ rnam lnga'i mthar pad skor med pa'i rang rgya sil rol/ sman rag gtor gsum sngags lan gsum/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'jam gdangs/ kaṃ raṃ chad nas rol chen sum brdung 'jog med nas e las nam mkha' sogs/ ye shes lnga ru dbang bskur ro/ zhes pa nas rol tshags/ 'jam 'don gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ badzra sā ma dzaḥsogs nas/ spyan 'dren mchod pa sogs bsnyen pa'i mtha' bar btang*/ seng gdong ma bdag bskyed pa'i rjes su srung dmigs dang sngags brgya rtsa sbyar/ bdag bskyed bsnyen bstod mthar mdun bskyed btang*/ bsnyen sngags mjug bsrung bzlog gnyis ka sbyar ba gang bde dang bsnyen bstod bya/ de nas ma mgon lcam dral gyis gsol ka bstod pa'i mtha' bar btang*/ de nas lcam dral gnad yig las/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar sogs bsnyen dmigs mthar/ he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig gong non gyi bsnyen pa brgya rtsa sngon 'gros/ trag rakṣa sogs/ brgya rtsa dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i gsung gi hūm̐/ dngos su 'byor dang sogs nas/ sngags mthar sil rol/ hūm̐/ drag shul rdo rje'i sogs kyi bstod mthar gzhung gi bstod pa dang*/ skye med rdo rje'i mnga' gsol dang*/

sum cu rtsa gsum sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ de nas gza'/ tshe ring ma sogs gter gzhi'i bar btang*/ de nas tshogs byin rlabs mchod bshags bsgral gsum/ bskang ba rdo rje'i thol glu nas lhag ma'i bar btang*/ de nas nyin dang po nas gsum pa'i bar du/ mdos kyi stod 'phyongs sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba chen po sogs nas/ lcam dral yongs rdzogs mdos kyis bskang bar btang*/ de nas mdos bskang srid pa gzhir bzhengs dang*/ 'khrugs bskang gnyis ci tshar bsags/ de nas nyin bzhi pa'i phyi dro nas bdag mdun sngar ltar la lcam dral gyi mdos kyi stod 'phyongs sngar bzhin btags mthar bsad mdos su zhal bsgyur ba ni/ rang yi dam gyi sogs nas/ bya glags gzan la 'dzum pa ltar bsam la/ zhes pa dang*/ trag rakṣa sogs nas mā ra ya phaṭaḥces brgya'am/ nyer gcig bzla/ de nas seng gdong ma'i smad las gtor bzlog gi dbu'i bskul ba de yar blangs nas btang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ gser skyems zag pa med pa sogs/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud gdangs ma dmigs bya bskyed pa/ bden bdar sogs nas bla 'gugs sngags nyer gcig lokt+ri'i sngags bdun/ de nas phur bu snying kar 'dril zhing*/ bsgral ba dang*/ rten dang brten pa chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ zhes pa nas/ rtsa sngags dang*/ lokt+ri'i bcas mthar/ bstab pa ni/ dgra bgegs sogs nas rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sogs bar btang*/ de nas hūm̐ḥ rnam thar gsum ldan sogs nas/ byad gdon g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dus la bab// bar tshar grangs ci tshar bsags/ thun gtor 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐/ rnam pa nyi shu'i byang chub sogs nas/ bdag srung mi mthun dgra la bsgyur// zhes thun gtor dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ de nas bsad mdos kyi/ hūm̐/ dur khrod 'bar ba'i sogs nas/ sde brgyad gdon tshogs dgra la bsgyur// bar lan gsum/ de nas gzhung gi bskul ba nas/ chad brtan bkra shis bar mthar chags gzhung bzhin btang*/

nyin tha ma la/ sde brgyad gdon tshogs dgra la bsgyur// zhes pa nas/ zor mdos su zhal bsgyur ba ni/ nang sgo dbye ba/ dbang po rdo rje can la sogs zhes pa nas/ dkar phyogs srung ba'i grogs dan mdzod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ de nas chad mdo gnyis btang*/ brtan ma'i mgor phyi sgo dbye ba la/ lam gtor srid pa ho phyag can dang*/ mdos lam btod/ mdos zhal bsgyur nas/ mdos chen pho brang nang bzhugs sogs nas/ dgra khams thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlogs/ bar btang*/ de nas lam gtor srid pa ho phyag bcas kyis sna drangs/ sku glud/ mdos chen/ gtor chen bcas drangs nas 'phang sar slebs pa dang/ sde brgyad la gser skyems btang*/ dmigs bya dgug gzhug drag po lan gsum dang*/ a ka ros lan chags bsngo zhing*/ phyug gtor btang*/ mdos zer btang ba ni/ hūm̐/ mi mngon dbyings na sogs nas/ rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod// zhes pa'i bar gyi mdos zor dang*/ de nas gtor zor ni/ snga ma'i thun gtor 'phang tshig hūm̐/ rnam pa nyi shu'i sogs nas/ bdag srung mi mthun dgra la bsgyur// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bzlog sngags lan gsum mthar/ dgra bgegs dpung bcom gsum brdung*/ de nas brtan ma btang*/ srung 'khor bsgom/ sgo drung bro mnan bya/ nang du log nas/ tshe 'gugs dang dngos grub len pa sogs gzhung bzhin bya'o// ༈ rang gzhung gi bsnyen pa grub nas dkyil 'khor mdzes pa sogs kyis mchod cing*/ bde gshegs mgon po sogs kyis bstod nas/ 2 bar cha/ rang gi thugs ka nas sogs dang*/ las rbad kyi 'og cha/ rang gi phar mdun sogs nas bskyed pa'i steng du/ bdag yi dam sogs 'og cha bskyed chog gi rngams shing yod par bsam mo zhes pa'i bar ro/ de nas spyan 'dren bswo chos dbyings kun khyab zhes pa nas bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ zhes dang*/ bdud mgon gtor 'bul/ kyai/ bdud mgon srog gcod sogs nas sgrol cig zhes dang*/

gru gsum lcags khang nag po'i sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa mgon po'i thugs kar zla ba'i sogs spyi dang*/ bdag dang mdun gyi thugs ka nas sogs nas nag thul gyis bsad par bsam nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga na ghu ti sogs dang*/ sa sha pra ma sogs ci 'grub bya/ de nas shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs nas sha truṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar 'bod rbad bsad gsum ci 'grub byas rjes/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis mchod cing*/ bskal pa me ltar sogs gzhung gi bstod pa rgyas pa bya'o// gtor 'gugs rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs bya/ bdag yi dam lha yi nga rgyal ldan sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ mgon po chen po'i thugs dam ni// sogs dang*/ lha dmag bskul thung*/ bswo cha bing gsum/ byang shar ma rnams kyi rjes/ gser skyems zag pa med pa sogs/ bdud rtsi dpa' skyems/ kyai/ gsol lo mchod do sogs/ de nas gzu dpang*/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sogs nas/ mdun gyi dkon mchog gsum po sogs dang*/ bhyo/ steng gi lha rnams sogs nas mā ra ya dza dzaḥ de nas e khang bskyed pa ni/ mdun du e las sogs nas bstim mo/ dang gru gsum de'i nang du sogs nas gcig tu gyur/ dmod gyer ni/ dam nyams dgra bo las ngan khyod sogs nas/ 'dir khug cig ces pa'i bar/ 'gugs pa ni/ gzu dpang mgor bdag he ru ka'i sogs nas bstim mo// na mo rje btsun sogs dang*/ bdag he ru ka'i thugs ka sogs nas gzugs la bstim mo/ na mo/ drin chen sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ nṛ tri dza sogs/ bdag gi thugs ka hūm̐ las/ yang*/ na mo drin chen sogs dang*/ nṛ tri sogs 'gugs sngags brgya rtsa dang*/ pho nyas bkug cing gnad la dbab pa ni/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar sogs nas myur du khug ga na gu ti sogs/ dgra bo a karsha ya dza dzaḥsogs brgya rtsa bzla/ na mo/ sangs rgyas sogs khug cig dza dzaḥ de nas lha dbye bya ba ni/

hūm̐/ kha khwa mu kha sogs nas las mdzod cig ga na ghu ti sogs/ oṃ pa na mu rbad sogs nas phyes shig sogs brgya rtsa bzla/ hūm̐/ nga ni ma nyes sogs nas phyes la shog yang gong ltar sngags/ oṃ sa na sogs/ 'o sdang ba'i dgra bo sogs nas bhi na ya phaṭa/ sngags sngar bzhin/ 'dod gsol ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po sogs nas nam mkha' la phyor/ dmod bcol ni*/ dgra bo 'di sogs nas bstim cig nyes bsgrags/ hūm̐/ sems can chen po sogs nas bsgral bar bya/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sogs nas dza dzaḥ gha na ghu ti sogs/ gong de'i mjug gi dam nyams pa'i sogs bzla/ de nas dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la sogs nas rgyug rgyug bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las sogs nas gcan gzan god la gtogs pa ltar dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par bsam/ thun sngagags bzla/ phur rabs/ bswo sngon gyi bskal pa sogs nas hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas ma hā shu n+ya sogs nas/ drang pa sogs nas/ lta bu gcig bsgom/ oṃ e dharmā sogs nas sku gsung thugs kyi mgon pos sngon gyi dam tshig dran nas sogs bral bar bsam/ gru gsum nang du sogs nas bsad sngags mgo mjug ldog hūm̐/ mgon po sku mchog sogs nas phral bar bsam/ thun sngags/ arghaṃ sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ sku yi mgon po gtum byed ni// sogs kyis bstod/ bdud rtsi dpa' skyems kyi phrin las bcol/ gzhan gnyis de'i 'gre'o/ mdun gyi ma hā kā la sogs nas/ gcog par bsam/ gu ṇa hri da sogs nas hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar bzla/ bswo/ mgon po sku yi dkyil 'khor sogs/ thun yongs rdzogs/ tshe khrus sogs byas nas/ hūm̐/ mi nag mgo gsum thugs dam dus la bab sogs/ thun re re bzhin thun sngags rgyas pa bya/ de nas/ ho/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sogs nas phrin las mdzod cig zhal bstab ni/ kho'i lus khyab par sogs nas gsol bar bsam/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po sogs nas/ khā hi/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/
hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus// sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bzlog pa sogs la 'jug go// /
